steps.text: Sauce: onion (30/40 g) diced into the oil (3 g flat, rapeseed — hot pan), 4 minutes.
Passata (100/120 g), garlic, oregano and a pinch of sugar (1 g). Simmer 10 minutes while you do everything else.
Chicken (90/120 g) butterflied, opened out flat, then bashed to 1 cm. Salt both sides.

Panko (18/22 g) mixed with the parmesan (12/15 g) and the rest of the oil (6/8 g, rapeseed), rubbed through your fingers until it looks like damp sand. No egg wash — press it onto the damp chicken dry and firm.
Courgette (180/200 g) in 1 cm coins, tossed with salt, spread on the tray around the chicken.
Then mozzarella (35/45 g) torn over the chicken only, 5 minutes more until it blisters.
Sauce spooned around the base, never over the crumb.

why: Parmesan in the crumb instead of egg beneath it. An egg wash makes a thick soft layer that steams under the cheese; a dry parmesan-and-oil crumb pressed onto damp chicken sticks well enough and stays crisp.
notes: D0-003: both oil uses (sauteing the sauce onion, binding the panko crumb that then bakes) are cooking uses, not dressing/finishing — whole row renames olive_oil -> rapeseed_oil (9/11 g, unchanged grams), restated as 3 g flat at the sauce step plus 6/8 g remainder at the crumb step (3+6=9 her, 3+8=11 him).

Seasoning: 'a pinch of sugar' weighed at 1 g (both covers), matching how the same cross-file sugar id is treated in the sibling Week A card a-d2d — see _ingredients.B.json's sugar note. Macro impact negligible (~4 kcal/cover).

Two tracks: sauce (hob, ready by clockStart 15) and oven (chicken prep -> bake -> cheese, critical path to clockStart 29). Sauce sits ready and waits; total critical path ~29 min against the card's 28-minute chip.
